supportive_queries.title: Git child process lineage
supportive_queries.description: Inspect child processes spawned by git.exe on the impacted host.
supportive_queries.spl_query: index=endpoint host=$host$ parent_process_name=git.exe | stats count values(process_name) as child_processes values(cmdline) as cmdlines by host, user, parent_process_name

supportive_queries.title: Rare git child processes across environment
supportive_queries.description: Find uncommon child processes spawned from git to spot anomalies.
supportive_queries.spl_query: index=endpoint parent_process_name=git.exe | stats count by process_name | eventstats sum(count) as total | eval pct=round((count/total)*100,2) | where pct<1 | sort -count

supportive_queries.title: Interactive logons by service account
supportive_queries.description: Review interactive logon events for the service account over the last 24h.
supportive_queries.spl_query: index=wineventlog sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security host=$host$ user=$user$ EventCode=4624 Logon_Type=2 | stats count values(WorkstationName) as workstations values(ProcessName) as processes by user, host

supportive_queries.title: Service account usage across hosts
supportive_queries.description: Identify where else this service account has logged on interactively.
supportive_queries.spl_query: index=wineventlog sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security user=$user$ EventCode=4624 Logon_Type=2 | stats count by host, Logon_Type | sort -count

supportive_queries.title: Ngrok network egress
supportive_queries.description: Show outbound connections related to ngrok from the host.
supportive_queries.spl_query: index=network (dest_port=443 OR dest_port=80) (dest_hostname=*ngrok.io OR dest_ip=* ) host=$host$ | stats count values(dest_ip) as dest_ips values(dest_hostname) as dest_hosts by host, process, user

supportive_queries.title: Ngrok processes on impacted host
supportive_queries.description: List ngrok processes and command-lines on the affected Linux host.
supportive_queries.spl_query: index=linux sourcetype=linux:ps host=$host$ (process=ngrok OR cmdline=*ngrok*) | table _time host user process cmdline parent_process

supportive_queries.title: Test 1
supportive_queries.spl_query:
index=Windows sourcetype=XmlWinEventLog source="*Sysmon*"
EventCode=1
Image="*certutil.exe*"
| search host="NDC56-1"
| table _time, host, User, Image, CommandLine, ParentImage, ParentCommandLine, Hashes, ProcessGuid
| sort 0 -_time

supportive_queries.title: Test 2
supportive_queries.spl_query:
index=Windows sourcetype=WinNetMon 
ProcessName="*certutil.exe*"
| search host="NDC56-1"
| stats count earliest(_time) as first_seen latest(_time) as last_seen 
        values(RemoteAddress) as Destination_IPs values(RemotePort) as Ports
  by ProcessName
| eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), 
       last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
| sort -count

supportive_queries.title: Recent in-memory PowerShell by host & user
supportive_queries.description: Pivot on host/user to see other in-memory PowerShell executions in the last 24h.
supportive_queries.spl_query: index=security sourcetype=XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational host=$host$ user=$user$ Message="*System.Management.Automation*" | stats count values(ScriptBlockText) as script_blocks by _time, host, user | sort -_time

supportive_queries.title: Script block hashes for correlation
supportive_queries.description: Generate hashes of script blocks to correlate across endpoints.
supportive_queries.spl_query: index=security sourcetype=XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational host=$host$ user=$user$ | eval script_hash=sha1(ScriptBlockText) | stats dc(script_hash) as distinct_hashes values(script_hash) as hashes by user, host | sort - distinct_hashes

supportive_queries.title: Access patterns for exposed bucket
supportive_queries.description: Summarize access to the exposed storage bucket from different IPs.
supportive_queries.spl_query: index=cloud_storage bucket_name=$bucket_name$ | stats count dc(src_ip) as distinct_ips values(method) as methods by bucket_name, src_ip | sort -count

supportive_queries.title: Suspicious geolocation for bucket access
supportive_queries.description: Highlight access from unusual geographies to the exposed bucket.
supportive_queries.spl_query: index=cloud_storage bucket_name=$bucket_name$ | iplocation src_ip | stats count by Country, City, src_ip | sort -count

supportive_queries.title: Authentication activity around brute-force window
supportive_queries.description: Look at successful and failed auth attempts around the time of the brute-force.
supportive_queries.spl_query: index=auth sourcetype=pingfederate host=$host$ user=$user$ | timechart span=5m count by outcome

supportive_queries.title: Source IP spray pattern
supportive_queries.description: Identify source IPs performing password spraying against PingFederate.
supportive_queries.spl_query: index=auth sourcetype=pingfederate signature=$signature$ | stats count dc(user) as distinct_users by src_ip | where distinct_users>5 | sort -count
